violations.title: Food Contact Surface, Clean after Use
violations.observation: Blacken food debris was observed on the cutting blade of the can opener
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be cleaned at any time during the operation when contamination may have occurred. PIC INSTRUCTED STAFF TO CLEAN CAN OPENER DURING THE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) in the walk-in cooler, carnitas were observed at 62f
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED THE FOOD.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Observed multiple unlabeled spray bottles of cleaning products in the kitchen and in chemical storage
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. PIC INSTRUCTED STAFF TO LABEL THE CLEANING PRODUCTS. SPRAY BOTTLES WERE LABELED AS DEGREASER, WINDEX, AND BLEACH. ALWAYS LABEL CHEMICAL BOTTLES.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Cutting Board, When to Resurface or Discard
violations.observation: Observed cutting boards heavily scored throughout the kitchen
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces such as cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC TO REPLACE CUTTING BOARDS AS THEY ARE HARDER TO SANITIZE.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed an unapproved backflow prevention device attached to the mop sink.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS PROVIDED PIC WITH INFORMATION ABOUT AN APPROVED BACKFLOW PREVENTION DEVICE. ORDER AND INSTALL.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed no handwashing sign posted at the hand sink next to the kitchen doors in the dining area.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. EHS PROVIDED PIC WITH A HANDWASHING SIGN TO POST.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) in the 2DWR under flat top cooler; roasted corn (64f), carnitas (46f), shredded cheese (52f). 2) on the cold line; shredded lettuce (46f), avocado crema (49f), mixed greens (48f). Upon discussion with PIC, all the food was put on the line 3 hours prior.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC WILL DISCARD ALL THE FOOD IN 1 HOUR. ENSURE ALL FOOD IS DISCARDED AFTER EVERY 4 HOURS. DO NOT SAVE ANY FOOD.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following foods being stored past its date marked date: Mexican rice, ROP black beans, and shrimp
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. PIC DISCARDED THE FOOD.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 2DWR under flat top cooler was observed 49f
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. DISCONTINUE STORING TCS FOODS IN THIS COOLER UNTIL REPAIRS ARE MADE. COOLERS WORK BEST WHEN SET TO 32f-38f

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: Observed staff not washing their hands after changing gloves.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. PIC INSTRUCTED STAFF MEMBER TO REMOVE GLOVES AND WASH HANDS BEFORE PUTTING ON NEW GLOVES. HAND WASHING MUST OCCUR AFTER CHANGING TASKS AND BEFORE PUTTING NEW GLOVES ON, ESPECIALLY WHEN HANDLING RAW PROTEINS AND ALLERGENS. SEE WHEN TO WASH HANDOUT/FACT SHEET.

violations.title: Gloves, Use Limitation (Single-Use Gloves)
violations.observation: Observed staff with gloved hands touch cooked chicken and raw shrimp without changing gloves.
violations.corrective_action: If used, single-use gloves shall be used for only ONE task and used for no other purposes. The single-use gloves shall be discarded when damaged or soiled or when interruptions occur in the operation. PIC INSTRUCTED STAFF TO CHANGE GLOVES IN BETWEEN HANDLING COOKED FOODS AND RAW FOODS TO AVOID CROSS CONTAMINATION. SEE GLOVES USE HANDOUT/FACT SHEET. UNCLE JULIO'S RIO GRANDE CAFE (Inspection Date: 03/20/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Compliance with variance, specialized process, HACCP

violations.title: Compliance with Variance and HACCP Plan
violations.observation: The permit holder is not in compliance with the HACCP plans and procedures that were submitted as specified in 8-201.14 and approved as a basis for the modification or waiver. EHS observed incomplete temperature logs for cooling.
violations.corrective_action: EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT ALL COMPONENTS TO THE HACCP PLAN NEEDS TO BE RETAINED ON SITE. COMPLETED LOGS MUST BE RETAINED FOR 6 MONTHS. THIS IS TO VERIFY THE COMPLIANCE OF THE FOOD ESTABLISHMENT’S OWN HACCP PLAN. PLEASE HAVE THIS CORRECTED BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: EH observed salsa being held on time outside of a coldwell or ice with no written 4 hr end point
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to-eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. PIC wrote end points on salsa containers

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Wash Temp for Hot Water Warewashing Machines
violations.observation: The wash water temperature of the hot water sanitizing warewashing machine is not meeting the manufacturer's specifications. The minimum temperature was 160 while the actual temperature was 135
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution in spray type warewashers that use hot water to sanitize may not be less than: 1) 165F for a stationary rack, single temperature machine, 2) 150F for a stationary rack, dual temperature machine, 3) 160F for a single tank, conveyor, dual temperature machine, or 4) 150F for a multitank, conveyor, multitemperature machine. PIC Had Dishmachine company repair man fix machine during inspection
